purpose: Teach: ハンサム/ニコチン/馬力/ハイウェイ/アスファルト/鰻/怪談/ニンジン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハンサムな先輩に憧れてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you've got a thing for that handsome senior, haven't you?
lines.style: Playful jab, knowing smirk in the voice. Quick, sharp attack. She's testing him and enjoying it. Small laugh threaded through.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、ニコチンに苦しんでたな、桜
lines.en: Your dad had a rough time with nicotine, didn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet pivot. Steady, almost gentle. He's deflecting with observation — calling her out softly, turning the tables with something real. No edge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、馬力強い車好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you're into those high-horsepower cars, right?
lines.style: Persistence with curiosity. Lighter than before — she's moved on from the teasing, genuinely wondering. Friendly, conversational cadence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でハイウェイドライブ行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You've done highway drives with your family, haven't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet turn-about. Matching her rhythm. He's meeting her curiosity with his own — not mocking, just observing back. Steady, even-toned.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アスファルトの上で寝そべるなよ
lines.en: Riku — don't you dare lie down on the asphalt.
lines.style: Sharp directive, almost mock-stern. She's switching modes — half-joking warning, half genuinely exasperated. Brief, firm on the opening word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、土用の鰻食ったろ?桜
lines.en: You ate eel during Doyo season, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle shift. Curious again, but softer. He's offering a lighter topic, checking in. No pressure in the question — just noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭で怪談の出し物やったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you did that ghost story skit at the culture festival, right?
lines.style: Warm interest. She's moved past testing and into genuine engagement. Relaxed pace, like she's remembering something fondly. Open, inviting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食のニンジン残すなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't leave your carrots on your lunch tray, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft exasperation mixed with faint affection. A small directive, almost caring. Not scolding — more like quiet persistence. Gentle close.
